_about: Research-based beginner curriculum (zero → CLB 4 in ~8 weeks at one unit/day). Vocabulary follows corpus frequency (Lonsdale & Le Bras, A Frequency Dictionary of French: the first 1,000 lemmas cover ~80% of everyday text; the first 2,000 ~86%); grammar order follows the CEFR reference inventories for French (Beacco et al., Niveau A1 / A2 pour le français) and the CLB 1–4 descriptors; pronunciation first (Fluent Forever principle) because sound discrimination gates listening and memory; every unit is one communicative can-do, i+1 over the previous unit, and is passed only by production (retrieval practice). Stage 3 introduces exam formats gently. Themes are Shishir's life (Toronto, security work, Nepal) because self-relevant material is retained better (self-reference effect).

stages.name: Survival & sounds
stages.focus: être/avoir/aller/faire, articles, numbers, questions, negation; nasal vowels, silent endings, liaison

stages.name: Daily life & the past
stages.focus: passé composé, futur proche, pronominal verbs, partitives, depuis + présent, prepositions; 700 most frequent words

stages.name: Telling & explaining
stages.focus: imparfait, COD/COI, relatives, comparatives, first opinions and connectors; first TCF-style listening/reading

units.title: Je m'appelle…
units.can_do: Greet, give your name, say where you're from and where you live.
units.pron: silent final consonants (Népal? no — Toronto: final o), nasal 'on' in bonjour/non
units.first_step: Say « Bonjour, je m'appelle Shishir » out loud three times.

units.title: Les nombres et l'heure
units.can_do: Count 0–20, say the time and the day.
units.first_step: Say the time right now in French.

units.title: Mon travail
units.can_do: Describe your job and hours with regular -er verbs.
units.pron: -e / -es / -ent endings are silent: je travaille = ils travaillent
units.first_step: Say « Je travaille à Toronto » and « Je commence à sept heures ».

units.title: Être, avoir, aller, faire
units.can_do: Use the four verbs everything else is built on.
vocab: je suis / tu es / il est / nous sommes / vous êtes / ils sont
j'ai / tu as / il a / nous avons / vous avez / ils ont
units.pron: j'ai vs j'aime; vous‿avez, ils‿ont liaisons; nous sommes /som/
units.first_step: Say all six forms of « être » once.

units.title: Poser des questions
units.can_do: Ask simple questions three ways and ask someone to repeat or slow down.
units.pron: rising intonation for yes/no questions; 'qu'est-ce que' = /kɛskə/
units.first_step: Ask « Vous pouvez répéter, s'il vous plaît ? » out loud.

units.title: La négation
units.can_do: Say what you don't do, don't have, don't understand.
vocab: je ne parle pas encore bien français
units.pron: 'ne' often dropped in speech (je sais pas) — recognise it, write it
units.first_step: Say « Je ne sais pas » and « Je n'ai pas de voiture ».

units.title: Ma famille
units.can_do: Talk about family and possessions; ages.
units.pron: mon‿ami liaison; final -e makes the consonant sound: grand /grɑ̃/ vs grande /grɑ̃d/
units.first_step: Say one sentence about your family.

units.title: Au café
units.can_do: Order, ask prices, pay; polite requests.
units.first_step: Order a coffee out loud: « Je voudrais un café, s'il vous plaît ».

units.title: En ville
units.can_do: Say where places are, ask for and give simple directions.
units.pron: à droite /adʁwat/; liaison 'tout‿droit' (no: tout droit /tu dʁwa/)
units.first_step: Ask « Où est le métro ? ».

units.title: Les transports
units.can_do: Say how you get around and when you leave/arrive.
units.first_step: Say how you get to work.

units.title: Ma journée
units.can_do: Describe a routine day with pronominal verbs.
units.pron: me / te / se before vowel: je m'habille
units.first_step: Say « Je me lève à six heures ».

units.title: Révision 1 — un vrai dialogue
units.can_do: Hold a 6-line first conversation: greet, present yourself, ask two questions, close.
units.pron: rhythm: equal syllables, stress on the last one of the group
units.first_step: Introduce yourself in four sentences without looking.

units.title: Ce week-end (futur proche)
units.can_do: Talk about plans.
units.first_step: Say one plan for tomorrow.

units.title: Hier (passé composé avec avoir)
units.can_do: Say what you did yesterday.
units.first_step: Say three things you did yesterday.

units.title: Je suis allé (passé composé avec être)
units.can_do: Movement verbs in the past; agreement basics.
units.first_step: Say where you went last weekend.

units.title: Faire les courses
units.can_do: Shop for food: quantities, partitives.
units.first_step: Name five things you buy every week.

units.title: Chez le médecin
units.can_do: Say what hurts, make an appointment.
units.pron: 'au' /o/ vs 'à la' — the contraction rule in action
units.first_step: Say « J'ai mal à la tête ».

units.title: Le temps et les saisons
units.can_do: Weather, seasons, and depuis + present.
units.first_step: Say how long you've lived in Toronto (depuis + présent!).

units.title: Au téléphone
units.can_do: Leave a message, spell your name, give a number; imperative.
units.pron: the French alphabet: e /ə/, g /ʒe/, j /ʒi/, w, y
units.first_step: Spell your surname in French.

units.title: Mon appartement
units.can_do: Describe where you live: rooms, adjectives, there is/are.
units.first_step: Describe your apartment in two sentences.

units.title: Les loisirs
units.can_do: Say what you like/dislike doing; frequency.
units.first_step: Say what you like doing on your day off.

units.title: Au travail — le rapport
units.can_do: Report an incident simply (past + time).
units.first_step: Say « Rien à signaler, tout est calme ».

units.title: Inviter et proposer
units.can_do: Invite, accept, refuse politely (writing task 1 seed).
units.first_step: Invite a friend for coffee out loud.

units.title: Quand j'étais petit (imparfait 1)
units.can_do: Describe the past: habits and background.
units.first_step: Say « Quand j'étais petit, j'habitais au Népal ».

units.title: Les vêtements et les couleurs
units.can_do: Describe people and clothes; plural agreement.
units.first_step: Describe your uniform.

units.title: Le futur simple
units.can_do: Talk about the future formally; conditions with si + présent.
units.first_step: Say one thing you will do next year.

units.title: Comparer
units.can_do: Compare places, jobs, seasons.
vocab: Toronto est plus grand que Katmandou
units.pron: plus: /ply/ before consonant, /plyz/ before vowel, /plys/ at the end
units.first_step: Compare Toronto and Kathmandu in one sentence.

units.title: Révision 2 — raconter sa semaine
units.can_do: Narrate a week: past, present, future in one story.
units.pron: linking: rhythm groups, no pauses inside them
units.first_step: Tell your week in four sentences.

units.title: Passé composé ou imparfait ?
units.can_do: Tell a short story with background and events.
units.first_step: Say « Il pleuvait quand je suis sorti ».

units.title: Le / la / les — pronoms COD
units.can_do: Avoid repeating nouns.
units.first_step: Say « Je le prends » about a coffee.

units.title: Lui / leur — pronoms COI
units.can_do: Say to whom.
units.first_step: Say « Je lui téléphone demain ».

units.title: Qui, que, où
units.can_do: Join sentences with relatives.
units.first_step: Say « La ville où j'habite est grande ».

units.title: Y et en
units.can_do: Use y / en for places and quantities.
units.first_step: Answer « Tu vas à Toronto ? » with y.

units.title: Donner son avis (1)
units.can_do: Give a simple opinion with reasons.
units.first_step: Give your opinion on Toronto winters in two sentences.

units.title: Organiser un texte
units.can_do: Sequence and structure: first, then, finally.
units.first_step: Describe how you start a shift in three steps.

units.title: Écrire un message (TCF tâche 1)
units.can_do: Write a 60-word message to a friend: describe, invite, thank.
units.first_step: Write two lines inviting a friend to lunch.

units.title: Cause et conséquence
units.can_do: Explain why and what follows.
units.first_step: Say why you're learning French, with parce que and grâce à.

units.title: Demander des informations (TCF tâche 2)
units.can_do: Ask 8 questions to enrol, rent, or register.
units.first_step: Ask three questions about a gym membership.

units.title: L'accord du participe passé
units.can_do: Get agreement right with être and preceding COD.
units.pron: agreement mostly silent — except écrit/écrite, pris/prise
units.first_step: Say « Elle est partie hier ».

units.title: Révision 3 — mon histoire
units.can_do: Tell your story in 10 sentences (Nepal → Toronto → job → French), past/present/future, one opinion.
units.first_step: Say the first three sentences of your story.
